steps.message: Execute: adb shell "service list | grep -i bluetooth; cmd bluetooth_manager help; cmd bluetooth help; dumpsys bluetooth_manager | grep -i -E 'enabled|state|name'"

arguments.command: python android_env.py adb "adb shell "service list | grep -i bluetooth; cmd bluetooth_manager help; cmd bluetooth help; dumpsys bluetooth_manager | grep -i -E 'enabled|state|name'""
